title: Father and Son, Forced Apart at the Border

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个美丽的、有50年历史的手工艺品的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听来自奥彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a five-year-old boy named Jose and his father fled the violence in Honduras and headed for the United States.
sentences.zh: 今天，一个名叫何塞的五岁小男孩和他的父亲为逃离洪都拉斯的暴力而前往美国。

sentences.en: They were separated at the border.
sentences.zh: 他们在边境骨肉分离。

sentences.en: What's happened to both father and son in the weeks since?
sentences.zh: 自那之后的几周里，父子俩都经历了什么？

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月20日，星期三。

sentences.en: When Jose and his dad arrive at the border, they meet the Trump administration's new zero-tolerance policy.
sentences.zh: 当何塞和他的爸爸抵达边境时，他们遇到了特朗普政府的新零容忍政策。

sentences.en: Every migrant trying to cross into the United States illegally is treated like a criminal.
sentences.zh: 每一个试图非法越境进入美国的移民都被当作罪犯对待。

sentences.en: Miriam Jordan covers immigration for The Times.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆·约旦为《时报》报道移民新闻。

sentences.en: So Jose's dad goes to detention and Jose gets put on a plane to Michigan to stay with a foster parent who has agreed to take him in.
sentences.zh: 因此，何塞的爸爸被送去拘留，而何塞则被送上了去密歇根的飞机，寄养在一个同意接纳他的寄养父母家里。

sentences.en: So what does that actually look like?
sentences.zh: 那么这到底是什么样子的呢？

sentences.en: Well, what it looks like is Jose and two other miners arrive with an escort after midnight at an airport in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 嗯，情况是这样的：何塞和另外两个未成年人在午夜过后由专人护送抵达密歇根的一个机场。

sentences.en: Jose's exhausted.
sentences.zh: 何塞筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: He emerges with this trash bag that's stuffed with his dirty clothes from his long trek across Mexico to reach the border, and two small pieces of paper.
sentences.zh: 他走出来时，手里拿着一个垃圾袋，里面塞满了他在穿过墨西哥抵达边境的长途跋涉中弄脏的衣服，还有两张小纸条。

sentences.en: One is a stick figure drawing of his family from Honduras.
sentences.zh: 一张是他画的洪都拉斯家人的简笔画。

sentences.en: The other is a sketch of his father who had been arrested and led away from him shortly before.
sentences.zh: 另一张是他父亲的素描，他父亲不久前刚被逮捕并被带离他身边。

sentences.en: So these are two drawings that he's made.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他画的两幅画。

sentences.en: Well, he actually didn't make the drawings.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实这些画不是他画的。

sentences.en: The drawings were made, according to Jose's account, by una señora.
sentences.zh: 根据何塞的说法，这些画是一位女士画的。

sentences.en: So we don't know if this was someone who was on the journey with him and with his father, or if it was a U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道这是否是和他及他父亲一起踏上旅程的人，或者是最初帮助何塞的美国官员。

sentences.en: official who helped Jose initially.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道。

sentences.en: We just don't know.
sentences.zh: 但这些画画的是他的家人和他的爸爸，他下飞机时紧紧抓着它们。

sentences.en: But they were drawings of his family and of his dad, and he's holding on to them as he gets off the plane.
sentences.zh: 是的，他紧紧抓着它们，就像抓住救命稻草一样。

sentences.en: Yes, and he's holding on to them for his dear life.
sentences.zh: 谁去接他下飞机的呢？

sentences.en: And who is there to meet him when he gets off this plane?
sentences.zh: 接他的是一位名叫珍妮斯的美国女性。

sentences.en: He's met by an American woman named Janice.
sentences.zh: 他下了飞机，她向他伸出手，但他不肯握。

sentences.en: He gets off the plane, and she stretches out her hand to him, and he won't take it.
sentences.zh: 他不愿意碰她的手？

sentences.en: He won't touch her hand?
sentences.zh: 他不想跟她有任何接触。

sentences.en: He wants nothing to do with her.
sentences.zh: 当然，他真的很累也很迷茫。

sentences.en: Of course, he was really tired and confused.
sentences.zh: 他就是不肯放开那些照片。

sentences.en: He won't let go of the pictures.
sentences.zh: 最初的几天里，他怎么都无法被安抚。

sentences.en: For the first few days, he can't be soothed.
sentences.zh: 他在床上辗转反侧。

sentences.en: He tosses and turns.
sentences.zh: 他整夜无法入眠。

sentences.en: He can't sleep through the night.
sentences.zh: 他在哭泣和呻吟之间交替。

sentences.en: He alternates between crying and moaning.
sentences.zh: 连续好几天，他拒绝脱掉到达时穿的那身衣服。

sentences.en: He refused to take off the clothes he'd arrived in for several days.
sentences.zh: 在珍妮斯看来，这是因为他不想让任何人拿走任何与他过去和父亲及家人相连的东西。

sentences.en: And as Janice sees it, it's because he didn't want anyone taking anything away from him that connected him to the past of being with his father and his own family.
sentences.zh: 那她最后有没有让他换衣服？

sentences.en: So does she eventually get him to change his clothes?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 最终，他允许她脱下他的袜子、过大的黄色T恤、海军蓝运动裤和灰色抓绒套头衫，并给他洗了澡，他也听从了指挥。

sentences.en: Eventually, he allows her to peel off his socks and his oversized yellow T-shirt and navy blue sweatpants and gray fleece pullover bathes him, and he follows directions.
sentences.zh: 但正如珍妮斯所说，他竖起了一道防线。

sentences.en: But as Janice put it, he kept up a little wall.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天发生了什么？

sentences.en: And what happens over the next few days?
sentences.zh: 嗯，何塞开始适应他暂时的家，并开始去上一个混龄幼儿园。

sentences.en: Well, Jose starts to get acclimated to his temporary home, and he begins attending a multi-age kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 他和其它说西班牙语的移民儿童在一起。

sentences.en: He's there with other Spanish-speaking migrant children.
sentences.zh: 他开始玩耍。

sentences.en: He begins to play.
sentences.zh: 他踢足球和玩传接球，但他仍然每天都在询问他的家人和他的父亲。

sentences.en: He plays soccer and catch, but he's still asking about his family and his father every single day.
sentences.zh: 而且他还是不肯放开那些照片。

sentences.en: And he still won't let go of those pictures.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他每天晚上都把照片塞在枕头底下。

sentences.en: I mean, he tucks the pictures under his pillow each night.
sentences.zh: 事实上，珍妮斯开始担心它们会被弄坏，所以她游说他同意让她把它们过塑，她后来确实这么做了。

sentences.en: In fact, Janice became worried that they were so afraid that they were going to tear, so she convinced him to let her laminate them, which she does at one point.
sentences.zh: 珍妮斯跟我讲了一个故事，关于一天晚上她哄他睡觉时发生的事情。

sentences.en: Janice told me a story about something that happened one night when she was putting him to bed.
sentences.zh: 突然，何塞宣布，我星期六要跟我爸爸一起去。

sentences.en: And suddenly, Jose announces, I'm going with my papa on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，（珍妮斯）不知道该作何反应。

sentences.en: Thanks, and doesn't know exactly how to respond.
sentences.zh: 然后她镇定下来，说，你知道的，亲爱的，我觉得不会是这周六。

sentences.en: And then gathers herself and says, you know, mi amor, I don't think it will be this Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我们还得弄清楚你爸爸在哪里，这样我们才能给他打电话，然后再看情况。

sentences.en: We still have to get some information about where your dad is so that we can call him, and then we'll see.
sentences.zh: 所以何塞听进去了，算是吧，请求留在房间里，因为他不想独自一人。

sentences.en: So Jose listens, sort of, please stay in the room, because I don't want to be alone.
sentences.zh: 那么这些像珍妮斯和她的家人这样收留像何塞这样的孩子的家庭是谁呢？

sentences.en: So who are these families, like Janice and her family, that take in children like Jose?
sentences.zh: 这是一个什么样的系统？

sentences.en: What is this system?
sentences.zh: 在全国各地，政府与专门将儿童安置在寄养家庭的非营利组织签约。

sentences.en: So across the country, the government contracts non-profits that specialize in placing children with foster families.
sentences.zh: 其中许多机构，比如天主教慈善会、路德会家庭服务中心，或者就何塞而言的伯大尼基督教服务中心，

sentences.en: Many of these, like Catholic Charities and Lutheran Family Services or Bethany Christian Services, in the case of Jose,
sentences.zh: 都有专门针对无人陪伴未成年人的项目，这些儿童自2013-2014年人数激增以来一直穿过边境来到这里。

sentences.en: have programs that are specifically for unaccompanied minors who have come across the border since their numbers began to surge in 2013-2014.
sentences.zh: 所以珍妮斯的家庭以前就参加过那个项目。

sentences.en: So Janice's family had participated in that program before.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个在奥巴马总统任期内创建的、用于处理独自来到美国的无人陪伴未成年儿童的系统，

sentences.en: So the system that was created to deal with children who came to the United States alone as unaccompanied minors under President Obama
sentences.zh: 现在正被用来处理那些因特朗普政府将他们与父母分离的政策而变成无人陪伴儿童的孩童。

sentences.en: is now being used to deal with children who are being made into unaccompanied minors by the Trump administration's policy of separating them from their parents.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 这个系统现在正利用其家庭网络并招募新家庭，来安置在边境与父母骨肉分离的儿童。

sentences.en: This system is now tapping into its network of families and recruiting new families to accommodate the children who have been separated from their parents at the border.
sentences.zh: 那么珍妮斯对此怎么看？作为一个认为自己的角色是为无人陪伴未成年人提供避难所的人，

sentences.en: So how does Janice think about this, as someone who saw her role as being this place of refuge for unaccompanied minors,
sentences.zh: 但现在却被安排照顾那些与父母分离的儿童？

sentences.en: but who is now being given children who are being separated from their parents?
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 何塞是这个家庭接收的第一个与父母一起越境而不是独自越境，随后又被强行与父母骨肉分离的孩子。

sentences.en: Jose is the first child that the family has taken in who crossed the border with a parent rather than alone, and then was forcibly separated from the parent.
sentences.zh: 何塞根本不知道他父亲在哪里。

sentences.en: Jose has no idea where his father is.
sentences.zh: 他不知道自己什么时候能再见到他或跟他说上话。

sentences.en: He doesn't know when he will see him or talk to him again.
sentences.zh: 而且何塞比他们接待过的大多数其他无人陪伴未成年人都要小得多。

sentences.en: And Jose is much younger than most of the other unaccompanied minors they hosted.
sentences.zh: 那些无人陪伴的未成年人知道他们在美国有家人。

sentences.en: Those unaccompanied minors knew they had family in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们独自越境，带着一张纸条，或者背熟了家人的电话号码。

sentences.en: They had come across the border alone with a piece of paper or having memorized the telephone number of their family members.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己到达美国时或至少在抵达后不久就会与家人见面。

sentences.en: They knew they were going to meet on arrival in the United States or at least shortly after their arrival.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，有太多未解的问题。

sentences.en: In this case, there's so many unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不知道他爸爸在哪里。

sentences.en: They don't even know where his dad is.
sentences.zh: 目前一切都太不透明了。

sentences.en: Everything is so opaque currently.
sentences.zh: 我是说，连高级行政官员都表示，他们不确定有多少儿童在与父母分离后又与父母团聚了。

sentences.en: I mean, even senior administration officials have said that they're not sure how many children have been reunited with their parents after being separated from them.
sentences.zh: 而且这个过程中涉及了太多不同的机构。

sentences.en: And there are so many different agencies involved in this process.
sentences.zh: 有国土安全部。

sentences.en: There's the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 有卫生与公众服务部。

sentences.en: There's Health and Human Services.
sentences.zh: 有司法部。

sentences.en: There's the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 而这些机构之间并不一定会互相沟通。

sentences.en: And those agencies are not necessarily all talking to each other.
sentences.zh: 事情可能会被忽视。

sentences.en: And things can fall through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 儿童可能会被体制遗漏。

sentences.en: Children can fall through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 那么现在更普遍的做法是，儿童被送往我们一直看到和听到的小孩所在的政府设施，

sentences.en: So is the more common practice right now that children are going to these government facilities that we've been seeing about and hearing about and that foster care,
sentences.zh: 而像何塞现在进入的那种寄养照顾，是一个不太常见的结果吗？

sentences.en: like what Jose is entering, is a less common outcome?
sentences.zh: 这很难让我评判，因为政府没有提供任何数据来表明有多少孩子在我们的设施里，

sentences.en: It's hard for me to judge because there haven't been any numbers supplied by the government in terms of this many kids are in our facilities and, you know,
sentences.zh: 有多少孩子在寄养家庭中。

sentences.en: that many kids are in foster care.
sentences.zh: 但我确实相信，更普遍的做法是将儿童留在这些独立运营的持牌收容所或设施中。

sentences.en: But I do believe that the more common practice is to keep children in these licensed shelters or facilities that are independently run.
sentences.zh: 何塞也可能是因为年纪太小才最终进入了寄养家庭。

sentences.en: And Jose might have also ended up with a foster family because he's so young.
sentences.zh: 很难确切知道。

sentences.en: It's hard to know for sure.
sentences.zh: 我的直觉是，因为他年纪偏小，他们更倾向于把较小的孩子安置在一个更温馨的环境里。

sentences.en: My hunch is that it's because he's on the young side and they prefer to place younger kids in a more intimate setting.
sentences.zh: 此外，政府设施已经人满为患。

sentences.en: In addition, the government facilities are packed.
sentences.zh: 它们的入住率超过了95%。

sentences.en: They're at 95 percent capacity plus.
sentences.zh: 但也有可能是因为何塞在分离发生时及不久后受到了极大的创伤，

sentences.en: But it could also be that Jose was extremely distressed by the separation when it occurred and shortly after,
sentences.zh: 促使当局更倾向于提供一个更有滋养作用的更温馨或更小的家庭环境。

sentences.en: prompting authorities to prefer a more intimate or smaller family environment that would be more nurturing.
sentences.zh: 所以此时此刻，何塞已经和他的父亲分开好几个星期了。

sentences.en: So at this point, Jose has been apart from his father for several weeks now.
sentences.zh: 他和他爸爸之间有过任何联系吗？

sentences.en: Has there been any contact between he and his dad?
sentences.zh: 我想大约在他到达密歇根10天左右后，他第一次跟父母通了电话。

sentences.en: I think about 10 days or so after he arrived in Michigan, he spoke with his parents for the first time.
sentences.zh: 电话是分别打给他在洪都拉斯的母亲和在拘留所的父亲的。

sentences.en: The phone calls were separate with his mother in Honduras and his father in detention.
sentences.zh: 珍妮斯告诉我，电话打得很顺利。

sentences.en: Janice tells me the calls went smoothly.
sentences.zh: 但随后她也意识到，这一切都改变了。

sentences.en: But then she also realizes that they changed everything.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，他心里明白了，根本无从得知何塞什么时候才能见到他的父亲或家人。

sentences.en: Somehow, it's sunk in that there was no way of knowing when Jose would see his father or his family.
sentences.zh: 这再次触发了分离创伤。

sentences.en: And it triggers this separation trauma again.
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 当他们到家时，她拿给他一些玩具。

sentences.en: When they arrive home, she offers him some toys.
sentences.zh: 他愤怒爆发，尖叫哭泣了将近一个小时。

sentences.en: He erupts in anger, screaming and crying for almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 她说，看着这一幕简直太难受了。

sentences.en: It was incredibly hard to watch, she said.
sentences.zh: 他脸上的表情是一种纯粹痛苦的表情。

sentences.en: The look on his face was a look of pure anguish.
sentences.zh: 她不得不强忍泪水。

sentences.en: She had to fight back tears.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，他把那些他珍视的照片扔到了厨房地板上，泣不成声。

sentences.en: And then along the way, he flung the pictures that he cherished or treasured onto the kitchen floor, sobbing.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《交易通》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的“交易通”峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化界最具影响力的领袖，

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 包括J·D·万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在NYTimes.com上免费直播精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 那么，米里亚姆，像何塞父亲这样的人在与儿子分离后被带到哪里去了？

sentences.en: So, Miriam, where is someone like Jose's father taken after he is separated from his son?
sentences.zh: 嗯，何塞的父亲很可能是被转送到边境附近的一个拘留中心，

sentences.en: Well, Jose's father was most likely transferred to a detention center near the border
sentences.zh: 在那里他将等待听证会，并因非法入境面临刑事指控。

sentences.en: where he would wait until his court hearing where he would be criminally charged for entering the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 事实上，前几天我就在其中一场听证会上。

sentences.en: And I was there the other day at one of these hearings, actually.
sentences.zh: 在这些听证会上究竟会发生什么，比如你参加的那场？

sentences.en: And what actually happens in these hearings, like the one you attended?
sentences.zh: 这一天是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: How does the day start?
sentences.zh: 一车被拘留者抵达法院。

sentences.en: A busload of detainees arrives at a court.
sentences.zh: 每个人都戴着脚镣，蹒跚着下车，进入一栋建筑，在那里他们被允许与指派给他们的律师会面。

sentences.en: Everyone is shackled, shuffles off the bus and into a building where they're allowed to meet with attorneys who have been assigned to them.
sentences.zh: 说西班牙语的律师会解释听证会期间会发生什么，以及像何塞爸爸这样的人有哪些选择。

sentences.en: The attorneys who are Spanish speakers explain what will happen during the hearing, what the options are for someone like Jose's dad.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，移民会选择认罪。

sentences.en: And typically, the migrant will choose to plead guilty.
sentences.zh: 然后前七名被告鱼贯进入这个房间。

sentences.en: Then the first seven defendants file into this room.
sentences.zh: 他们在法官面前排成一排。

sentences.en: They line up in front of the judge.
sentences.zh: 他们许多人仍然穿着长途跋涉时穿的那种沾满灰尘、汗流浃背的衣服。

sentences.en: Many of them are still in this kind of dusty, sweaty garb that they were wearing when they made the journey.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来茫然、疲惫，对自己的命运有些听天由命。

sentences.en: They look dazed, weary, kind of resigned to their fate.
sentences.zh: 他们的头微微低垂，许多人其实那天早上才刚刚结束穿过沙漠的旅程，被抓获并带了进来。

sentences.en: Their heads are kind of drooped, and many of them actually just finished their journey across the desert that morning and been apprehended and brought in.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚。

sentences.en: It's not clear.
sentences.zh: 法官开始了。

sentences.en: And the judge begins.
sentences.zh: 他说，下午好，告诉他们他的名字，并说诸如“你由一名不收取你任何费用的律师代表，

sentences.en: He says, good afternoon, tells them his name, and something like, you're being represented by a lawyer at no cost to you
sentences.zh: 因为你被控犯有非法入境的刑事罪”。

sentences.en: because you're charged with a criminal offense of illegal entry.
sentences.zh: 当他转向律师时，律师站在七名移民中的每一位身后，

sentences.en: When he turns to the lawyers, the lawyer stands behind each one of the seven migrants
sentences.zh: 并询问辩护律师：“你们的客户是否已决定放弃受审权利并进行有罪答辩？”

sentences.en: and asks counsels, have your clients made a decision to waive their right to a trial and enter guilty pleas?
sentences.zh: 律师们异口同声地回答：“是的，法官大人。”

sentences.en: The lawyers respond in unison, yes, your honor.
sentences.zh: 然后法官逐个点名，念出每个移民的名字，并询问他或她是否认罪。

sentences.en: Then the judge goes down the line, utters each migrant's name, and asks if she or he pleaded guilty.
sentences.zh: 接着法官依次走过去，念出每个移民的名字，并询问他们是否认罪。

sentences.en: And they're hearing the proceedings through headsets.
sentences.zh: 他们通过耳机听取法庭审理的内容。

sentences.en: There's an interpreter in the room, and each one says, see.
sentences.zh: 房间里有一名口译员，每个人都说“西”。

sentences.en: Number one says, see.
sentences.zh: 第一个人说“西”。

sentences.en: Number two says, see.
sentences.zh: 第二个人说“西”。

sentences.en: Down to number seven in the line, who says, see.
sentences.zh: 一直到队列中的第七个人，也说“西”。

sentences.en: Meaning, yes, I plead guilty to this offense.
sentences.zh: 意思是，是的，我对这项罪名认罪。

sentences.en: And what exactly is going on here?
sentences.zh: 这里到底在发生什么？

sentences.en: I haven't encountered a court scene like this ever.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有遇到过这样的法庭场景。

sentences.en: What is going on is that the government is trying to quickly hold hearings for folks who have been apprehended at the border.
sentences.zh: 正在发生的是，政府试图为在边境被捕的人快速举行听证会。

sentences.en: And there are large numbers of them.
sentences.zh: 而且人数众多。

sentences.en: It's time-consuming and expensive to do individual hearings.
sentences.zh: 进行单独听证既耗时又昂贵。

sentences.en: So they do what critics call assembly line justice.
sentences.zh: 所以他们做了批评者所说的流水线司法。

sentences.en: This is kind of like a factory of migrants coming through.
sentences.zh: 这有点像移民通过的工厂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like rapid fire proceeding where here's seven, then another seven, and then seven more.
sentences.zh: 这就像是连珠炮式的审判，这里是七个，然后又是七个，再来七个。

sentences.en: And by the end of it, 90 minutes or less later, 74 migrants had pleaded guilty to entering the United States illegally.
sentences.zh: 最终，在90分钟或更短的时间内，74名移民承认非法进入美国。

sentences.en: Is this a new phenomenon, what you observed in this courtroom?
sentences.zh: 这是个新现象吗，你在这个法庭里观察到的情况？

sentences.en: It's actually not a new phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 这其实并不是一个新现象。

sentences.en: It's known as Operation Streamline, launched by the Bush administration in 2005 as a deterrent to illegal crossing.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“流畅行动”，由布什政府于2005年发起，作为对非法越境的威慑。

sentences.en: It's not clear that it worked as a deterrent, but it sure speeded up the judicial process.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚它是否起到了威慑作用，但它确实加快了司法程序。

sentences.en: The Obama administration keeps the program, Operation Streamline, functioning.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府保留了“流畅行动”这一计划的运作。

sentences.en: But for the most part, I'm told by immigration attorneys, first-time offenders are spared.
sentences.zh: 但移民律师告诉我，在大多数情况下，初犯会被网开一面。

sentences.en: Under the Trump administration's zero-tolerance policy, this practice is back in full swing.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府的零容忍政策下，这种做法全面死灰复燃。

sentences.en: And first-time offenders are being hauled into court in large numbers.
sentences.zh: 大量初犯被带上法庭。

sentences.en: To handle those large numbers, courts in some parts of the country, like Texas, have up to 40 people in a courtroom all at once.
sentences.zh: 为了应对如此庞大的人数，德克萨斯州等部分地区的法院一次在法庭上容纳多达40人。

sentences.en: Miriam, I'm struck by how almost, like, farce-like this whole proceeding that you're describing is, because it has all the trappings of normal court hearings,
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，我感到震惊的是，你所描述的整个诉讼过程几乎就像是一场闹剧，因为它具备了正常法庭听证会的所有外表，

sentences.en: except it's being applied at such an astonishing scale to so many people simultaneously that it doesn't really resemble anything we've come to think of as American justice.
sentences.zh: 除了它是以如此惊人的规模同时应用于这么多人，以至于它看起来根本不像我们所认为的美国司法。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That's the reason why critics say that this assembly line justice undermines due process.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么批评者说这种流水线司法破坏了正当程序。

sentences.en: But this administration is determined to pursue this, and in fact, it's about to introduce Operation Streamline to California, which has long resisted the program.
sentences.zh: 但本届政府决心继续推进这一做法，事实上，它即将把“流畅行动”引入长期抵制该计划的加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: I think, from the government's perspective, these hearings are the answer, because if they, under the zero-tolerance policy,
sentences.zh: 我认为，从政府的角度来看，这些听证会就是答案，因为如果他们在零容忍政策下，

sentences.en: want to prosecute every illegal immigrant who enters the country, the only way to do it without completely overwhelming the federal courts is by having these mass hearings.
sentences.zh: 想要起诉每一个进入该国的非法移民，要在不彻底压垮联邦法院的情况下做到这一点的唯一方法就是举行这些集体听证会。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And these mass hearings, like the one you attended and are describing, these are the criminal proceedings that necessitate separating children like Jose from his father.
sentences.zh: 而这些集体听证会，就像你参加并描述的那样，正是导致像何塞这样的儿童与父亲分离的刑事诉讼。

sentences.en: Under the Trump administration's zero-tolerance policy, children like Jose have to go into either a government-licensed facility or enter foster care with strangers.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府的零容忍政策下，像何塞这样的孩子要么进入政府许可的设施，要么进入寄养家庭与陌生人生活在一起。

sentences.en: A parent, like Jose's dad, faces criminal charges in an assembly-like court setting.
sentences.zh: 像何塞父亲这样的家长，要在流水线式的法庭环境中面临刑事指控。

sentences.en: That's what it's all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部的意义所在。

sentences.en: So how does this day in court that you witnessed...
sentences.zh: 那么，你见证的这天法庭……

sentences.en: The migrants all get on the bus again.
sentences.zh: 移民们再次上了大巴。

sentences.en: Eventually, they're transferred to immigration custody.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们被转移到移民拘留所。

sentences.en: Most of them will likely be deported very quickly, unless they decide to apply for asylum, as we understand Jose's father did.
sentences.zh: 他们中的大多数人很可能会被非常迅速地驱逐出境，除非他们决定申请庇护，就像我们了解到的何塞的父亲所做的那样。

sentences.en: And that would initiate a completely separate bureaucratic and legal process of its own.
sentences.zh: 那将启动一个完全独立的官僚和法律程序。

sentences.en: And Miriam, what will happen to a child like Jose at this point, when their parent is convicted and sentenced, but attempting to apply for asylum?
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，当父母被定罪判刑但试图申请庇护时，像何塞这样的孩子此时会发生什么？

sentences.en: Clear, to be honeSt. Jose and his father are supposed to be reunified.
sentences.zh: 说实话，很明显。何塞和他的父亲本应团聚。

sentences.en: But in this environment, with all this uncertainty, the asylum process is a lengthy one that can take years.
sentences.zh: 但在这种环境下，在所有这些不确定性中，庇护程序是一个漫长的过程，可能需要数年时间。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, it's really not clear what will happen to Jose and his father.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，何塞和他的父亲究竟会遭遇什么，实在很不明确。

sentences.en: Miriam, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: I support, and all of the members of the Republican Conference support, a plan that keeps families together while their immigration status is determined.
sentences.zh: 我以及共和党党团的所有成员都支持一项在确定移民身份期间让家庭保持团聚的计划。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, congressional Republicans endorsed a legislative plan to end the practice of separating children from their parents at the border.
sentences.zh: 周二，国会共和党人赞同一项立法计划，旨在结束在边境将儿童与其父母分开的做法。

sentences.en: Their proposal, laid out by Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell, would allow parents and children to be detained together, while their legal status is established by courts.
sentences.zh: 他们的提案由参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔提出，将允许父母和孩子在法院确立其法律地位期间被共同拘留。

sentences.en: At the Republican National Convention, President Trump said about the problems of the nation, quote, I alone can fix it.
sentences.zh: 在共和党全国代表大会上，特朗普总统谈到国家的问题时说：“只有我能解决。”

sentences.en: In the case of family separation, it's actually true.
sentences.zh: 就家庭分离而言，这确实是真的。

sentences.en: But Democrats, including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, quickly rejected the plan, saying it was up to President Trump to end the practice, through his executive authority.
sentences.zh: 但包括参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默在内的民主党人迅速拒绝了该计划，称这取决于特朗普总统通过其行政权力来结束这种做法。

sentences.en: Mr. President, you alone can fix it.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，只有你能解决它。

sentences.en: In fact, the president alone can fix it with this flick of a pen by signing a presidential order
sentences.zh: 事实上，总统只要挥一下笔，签署一项总统令，就能独自解决这个问题

sentences.en: to end the agonizing screams of small children who have been separated from their parents.
sentences.zh: 以结束与父母分离的幼童痛苦的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I'll lend you my pen.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我把我的笔借给你。

sentences.en: Any pen.
sentences.zh: 任何笔都可以。

sentences.en: You can fix it yourself.
sentences.zh: 你自己就能解决它。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: It's Michael.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: There's been some questions about our decision not to run excerpts from a Times interview with Stephen Miller, the White House advisor.
sentences.zh: 对于我们决定不播放《泰晤士报》采访白宫顾问斯蒂芬·米勒的节选，有一些疑问。

sentences.en: Some further context.
sentences.zh: 以下是更多背景信息。

sentences.en: My colleagues Julie Davis and Michael Scheer interviewed Miller as part of their reporting for a print story
sentences.zh: 我的同事朱莉·戴维斯和迈克尔·希尔采访了米勒，作为他们为一篇印刷报道收集素材的一部分

sentences.en: on the White House's current practice of separating parents and children at the border.
sentences.zh: 关于白宫目前在边境分离父母和儿童的做法。

sentences.en: They had recorded it for fact-checking purposes, and it was only after the story was published, with on-the-record quotes from Miller, that The Daily requested to air the audio
sentences.zh: 他们录音是为了核实事实，直到报道发表、并且引用了米勒的公开言论之后，《每日新闻》才请求播放这段音频

sentences.en: as part of an interview with Julie about her reporting.
sentences.zh: 作为关于朱莉报道采访的一部分。

sentences.en: The White House objected because the terms of the original interview had not included its use on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 白宫对此提出异议，因为最初采访的基本规则中不包括在《每日新闻》上使用该音频。

sentences.en: We recognized that the ground rules for the interview were not clear, and so we made a decision not to use the audio.
sentences.zh: 我们认识到采访的基本规则不够明确，因此我们决定不使用该音频。

sentences.en: There was much discussion about this decision, and we took it very seriously.
sentences.zh: 关于这个决定有很多讨论，我们非常严肃地对待它。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《切割机秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会断片入睡。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在你喜欢的任何地方收听《切割机秀》。
